name: Western Sydney University Student Legal Service
summary: Free legal advice and referral for current WSU and The College students, funded by SSAF.
key: A free legal advice and referral service.
who: Current domestic and international students of Western Sydney University or The College
how: Submit the online Request for Help form, call 02 9685 4788 or email studentlegalservices@westernsydney.edu.au
Drop-in at the Justice Clinic, Parramatta South, Tuesdays 10am-3pm in teaching weeks
catches: No advice on issues involving the University

source.label: Western Sydney University: Student Legal Service

evidence.quote: The Student Legal Service (SLS) is a free legal advice and referral service.
